name: Dodge County, NE
findings: Dodge County has 137 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dodge County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Dodge County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
